title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a CRM and…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in a CRM and Support module endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated users with common operational roles to access email communications of documents they should not have permission to read by sending crafted requests referencing out-of-scope records. The vulnerability impacts confidentiality but does not affect system availability.
